payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over divisors using inclusion-exclusion to count compositions with gcd=1, precomputing powers of 2.
payload.rationale: The solution computes number of sequences summing to S with gcd 1 via f(S)=2^(S-1)-sum_{d|S,d<S} f(d), iterating over sorted factors. This is a classic counting DP/combinatorics technique.
